name: video-agent-kit
description: 一体化视频插件：视频理解与检索研究、剪辑、字幕、口播精简、电影解说与足球/篮球/英雄联盟赛事解说、单集与连续剧视频创作、人物替换，以及从录屏复刻网站/游戏/全栈应用；语音识别、配音与生成服务均通过已登录的 ZCode 账号调用 ZCode ToolHub，全部能力共享一套媒体工具与证据。

tts_voice.title: TTS default voice
tts_voice.description: VE_TTS_VOICE: default preset voice id for tts_generate and narration. Leave empty for the built-in default.

bgm_dir.title: BGM directory
bgm_dir.description: Optional music library directory for render_narrated.

max_inline_images.title: Max inline images
max_inline_images.description: Maximum images inlined in one MCP tool result before remaining paths are listed for Read.

description_i18n.en: Unified video plugin: understanding and research, editing, subtitles, talking-head condensing, narrated movie and soccer/basketball/LoL match recaps, standalone and serial video creation, person replacement, and replicating websites/games/full-stack apps from screen recordings; speech recognition, voiceover and generation run through ZCode ToolHub on the signed-in ZCode account, and every capability shares one set of media tools and evidence.
